Concept → Cinematic Vision → Structured JSON → Video

CHAIN: VisualThink (THINK) → VisualInstruct (INSTRUCT) → KeyframePromptScheduler → your LTX nodes

Type a scene concept into VisualThink. It generates a cinematic description.
VisualInstruct extracts structured JSON with style/mood/lighting/action keys.
The output JSON feeds into your video generation pipeline.
A neon-lit cyberpunk market in 2099, rain-slicked streets reflecting holographic advertisements, merchants in augmented reality visors haggling over mysterious tech artifacts.

VisualInstruct JSON OUTPUT:
{
  "content": "...",
  "style": "...",
  "camera_language": "...",
  "lighting": "...",
  "mood": "...",
  "palette": "...",
  "era": "...",
  "action": "..."   ← FIXED: action key now included
}

VisualThink OUTPUT:
CONTENT: A bustling cyberpunk market...
STYLE: Cinematic cyberpunk noir...
CAMERA LANGUAGE: Low-angle dolly shot...
LIGHTING: Neon and holographic glow...
MOOD: Gritty yet vibrant...
COLOR PALETTE: Magenta, cyan, deep indigo...
ERA: 2099 cyberpunk

ATTACH YOUR LTX PIPELINE HERE:

The KeyframePromptScheduler outputs per-frame prompts from the VisualInstruct JSON.

→ Use PGFX_LTXVInContextSampler as your video generator.
→ The "action" key in the JSON drives motion description for better video coherence.
→ Connect guiding_latents with IC-LoRA for in-context style transfer.
